meta.title: Gyumin Kim (김규민) · qminlab — one-person AI studio
meta.description: qminlab is the one-person AI studio of Gyumin Kim (김규민). Case files and links for the Weming app, the PC game DeepHold, an AI animation and Claude Wait Board, built with Claude Code, the Claude API, Seedance and ElevenLabs.

hero.label: Intro
hero.unfoldAria: Qmin: Q for Curious, min for Mean (CURIOUS-MEAN)
hero.keyMobile: Q = CURIOUS · MIN = MEAN · TAP TO UNFOLD
hero.body: qminlab is the one-person AI studio of Gyumin Kim (김규민). Working as an AI creator in Daegu, South Korea, since 2026 I have built and shipped apps, a desktop game, animation and work tools myself with generative AI: Claude Code, the Claude API, Seedance, ElevenLabs and more. Main work: the friend-finding app Weming (in App Store review, Google Play closed testing), the PC game DeepHold, the AI animation The Stellar Swordmaster, and Claude Wait Board, which shows the status of Claude Code tasks. Every project keeps a public case file and its process on GitHub.

projects.name: DeepHold
projects.one: A 2.5D pixel action game: farm random dungeons, build your own from the loot, and dare your friends to clear it.
projects.desc: No gear, no levels, three hits and you're out. It is a skill-only hardcore game, and every attack gets a readable wind-up so a death always feels like your own mistake.

projects.name: The Stellar Swordmaster
projects.one: Turning the opening arc of the webtoon “The Stellar Swordmaster” (based on the Korean novel of the same name) into one AI-animated episode.
projects.desc: Vlad, a back-alley orphan, dreams of a blacksmith's sword until the day he leaves the city of Shoara. I wrote the script and a 266-cut storyboard, then generate each cut with AI and polish the rhythm and direction one cut at a time.
projects.stageLine: In production · cut generation and polish
projects.stack: Seedance 2.5, ElevenLabs, ChatGPT Images, Claude, ffmpeg

projects.name: Claude Wait Board
projects.one: An iPad status board that shows every running Claude task at a glance
projects.desc: Like a pickup board at a fast-food counter, each task gets a number and moves between Working, Needs attention and Done. Tasks waiting on a permission prompt flash the whole screen red, finished ones flash green, with a chime for each. A small server on the Mac collects live signals from Claude app chats and Claude Code.
projects.stack: Python, HTML/JavaScript, Claude extension mods, Claude Code hooks

projects.name: Jarvis
projects.one: An AI assistant and supervisor that runs my daily life.
projects.stageLine: Paused · on hold while I focus on the game and the animation
projects.stack: Python, FastAPI, YOLO (object detection), Claude API, Whisper (speech recognition)
